# CraftCN - LLM Context Guide

> A "shadcn/ui" for Minecraft plugins. A Rust CLI that copies editable Paper UI building blocks into a project.

## What CraftCN does

CraftCN copies Java source files into a plugin project. It does not add a library dependency. Components are
ordinary source you own, living under your root package.

- Target: **Paper 26.2** (latest stable). Components compile against it and work back to Minecraft **1.21.4**.
  Individual components state their own minimum (`MC 1.21.6+` for dialogs).
- Only public Paper and Adventure APIs. No NMS, no shaded libraries.
- Components are written under the `com.craftcn` namespace. The CLI rewrites them to the project's package on install.

## CLI workflow

```bash
craftcn init --yes                 # detects package and paper-api version, installs base-menu and UITheme
craftcn list                       # components by category, with minimum Minecraft and dependencies
craftcn add paginated-menu         # installs dependencies first; existing files are kept unless --force
craftcn context paginated-menu     # public API summary (use -v for private members)
craftcn doctor                     # exits non-zero on errors
craftcn pack --zip                 # resource pack for texture-gui and resource-pack
craftcn theme apply neon           # switches theme and regenerates UITheme.java
craftcn remove animation           # refuses when other installed components depend on it
```

Registry source: `CRAFTCN_REGISTRY=/path/to/registry` uses a local checkout. Otherwise the registry is fetched from
GitHub and cached. `craftcn update` refreshes the cache.

## Project layout after init and a few adds

```
src/main/java/com/example/plugin/
├── ui/
│   ├── UITheme.java            # generated: colours, materials, sounds for the theme
│   ├── core/                   # base-menu
│   │   ├── BaseMenu.java       # holder-based menu base; open(), refresh(), close(), setButton()
│   │   ├── Button.java         # record: icon + Consumer<Click> + sound
│   │   └── MenuListener.java   # one listener per plugin, routes events to menus
│   ├── menus/                  # paginated-menu, confirmation-menu, selection-menu, dialog-menu
│   ├── forms/                  # form-menu (anvil text input)
│   ├── chat/                   # chat-prompt, interactive-message
│   ├── hud/                    # scoreboard-sidebar, bossbar-timer, toast-notification, hologram, animation, text-fx
│   ├── util/                   # item-builder, head-util, scheduler (Tasks)
│   ├── pack/                   # resource-pack (ResourcePackService)
│   └── textures/               # texture-gui (GuiFont, GuiIcons, TexturedMenu)
```

`craftcn.json` at the project root records the package, theme, target Minecraft version and installed components.

## Component catalogue

Category letters: A inventory GUIs, B chat, C HUD and visuals, D utilities, E resource pack GUIs.

| Component | Cat | Min MC | Depends on | Key API |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| base-menu | A | 1.21.4 | - | `BaseMenu(plugin, player, title, size)`, `build()`, `setButton`, `setItem`, `refresh`, `close`, `Button.of(icon, click -> ...)` |
| paginated-menu | A | 1.21.4 | base-menu, item-builder | `PaginatedMenu<T>(plugin, player, title, rows)`, `setSource`, `setRenderer`, `onItemClick`, `nextPage`, `previousPage` |
| confirmation-menu | A | 1.21.4 | base-menu, item-builder | `ConfirmationMenu(plugin, player, title, message)`, `setOnConfirm`, `setOnDeny` |
| selection-menu | A | 1.21.4 | base-menu, item-builder | `SelectionMenu<T>(plugin, player, title, size)`, `setItems`, `setMultiSelect`, `setOnSelectionComplete` |
| form-menu | A | 1.21.4 | base-menu, item-builder | `FormMenu(plugin, player, title, initialText, Consumer<String>)`, `future()` (anvil input) |
| dialog-menu | A | 1.21.6 | - | `DialogMenu.notice`, `confirm(...)` -> `CompletableFuture<Boolean>`, `choose(...)`, `form(title).textField/toggle/number(...).open(player)` |
| chat-prompt | B | 1.21.4 | scheduler | `ChatPrompt(plugin, player, prompt, callback, Duration)`, `start()`, `response()` |
| interactive-message | B | 1.21.4 | - | `InteractiveMessage.from(text).hover().clickCommand().clickCallback(audience -> ...).send(audience)` |
| scoreboard-sidebar | C | 1.21.4 | - | `ScoreboardSidebar(player, title)`, `setLines`, `setLine`, `addLine`, `show()` |
| bossbar-timer | C | 1.21.4 | scheduler | `BossBarTimer.create(plugin, title, Duration)`, `addViewer`, `start`, `stop`, `onComplete` |
| toast-notification | C | 1.21.4 | scheduler | `ToastNotification.to(player).title().description().icon().iconModel().frame(...).send(plugin)` |
| hologram | C | 1.21.4 | scheduler | `Hologram.spawn(plugin, location, text)` -> future; `text`, `move`, `remove` |
| animation | C | 1.21.4 | scheduler | `Animator.of(periodTicks, frames...)`, `loop`, `forPlayer(plugin, player, consumer)`, `global(...)` |
| text-fx | C | - | - | `TextFx.gradient`, `rainbow`, `shimmer`, `shimmerFrames`, `pulse`, `typewriterFrames` |
| item-builder | D | 1.21.4 | - | `ItemBuilder.from(material).name().lore().glint(bool).model(key).tooltipStyle(key).build()` |
| head-util | D | 1.21.4 | - | `HeadUtil.of(name)`, `HeadUtil.skin(url)` |
| scheduler | D | 1.21.4 | - | `Tasks.run(plugin, player, r)`, `later`, `repeat`, `at(plugin, location, r)`, `global`, `globalRepeat`, `async` |
| resource-pack | E | 1.21.4 | scheduler | `ResourcePackService(plugin, uri, sha1, required, prompt)`, `register()`, `onStatus`, `hasPack(player)` |
| texture-gui | E | 1.21.4 | base-menu, item-builder | `TexturedMenu(plugin, player, title, rows, Plate)`, `fillFrame()`, `GuiFont.title(plate, text)`, `GuiIcons.setPackCheck(...)` |

## Conventions for code generated from this registry

1. **Menus**: extend `BaseMenu`. Place clickable slots with `setButton(slot, Button.of(icon, click -> ...))`.
   Don't register inventory listeners. Clicks inside a menu are always cancelled.
2. **Threads**: touch a player only on that player's thread, using `Tasks.run(plugin, player, ...)`. Use
   `Tasks.at(plugin, location, ...)` for world objects. Don't use `Bukkit.getScheduler()` in new code, because it isn't
   Folia-safe. Async chat and other callbacks must hand back through `Tasks`.
3. **Text**: use Adventure `Component`s. Keep user-facing strings in named constants, not inline.
4. **Sounds**: `UITheme.CLICK`, `SUCCESS`, `ERROR`, `CLOSE`, `OPEN` are generated from the theme.
   Materials are `UITheme.FILLER_GLASS`, `NEXT_BUTTON`, `BACK_BUTTON`, `ERROR_ICON`, `SUCCESS_ICON`.
5. **Item data**: use `ItemBuilder.model(NamespacedKey)` for resource pack models and `tooltipStyle` for tooltip
   frames. Names and lore are non-italic by default.
6. **Resource pack**: `texture-gui` and `resource-pack` need `craftcn pack` output. Without the pack, players see the
   vanilla fallbacks. `GuiIcons.setPackCheck(resourcePack::hasPack)` chooses per player.
7. **Versions**: a component with `minecraft: 1.21.6` won't run on older servers. `craftcn add` and `craftcn doctor`
   warn when the project's target is older.

## Example: a shop with a confirmation

```java
import com.example.plugin.ui.core.Button;
import com.example.plugin.ui.menus.PaginatedMenu;
import com.example.plugin.ui.menus.ConfirmationMenu;
import com.example.plugin.ui.util.ItemBuilder;

PaginatedMenu<Shop.Item> shop = new PaginatedMenu<>(plugin, player, "Shop", 6);
shop.setSource(items);
shop.setRenderer(item -> ItemBuilder.from(item.icon()).name(item.name()).lore("Price: " + item.price()).build());
shop.onItemClick((item, click) -> {
    ConfirmationMenu confirm = new ConfirmationMenu(plugin, click.player(), "Buy?", "Buy " + item.name() + "?");
    confirm.setOnConfirm(() -> economy.buy(click.player(), item));
    confirm.open();
});
shop.open(); // call from the player's thread, see the scheduler component
```

## Verification

- `cargo test`: CLI unit tests, plus registry integrity (every file exists, dependencies resolve, package headers).
- `scripts/verify-components.sh`: installs every component into a Paper 26.2 project and compiles it with `-Xlint:all`.
  Needs JDK 25 and Maven.

## Limits to keep in mind

- The compile check and a headless server smoke test cover the code. Player-facing behaviour (clicks, dialogs, toasts
  on screen, resource pack rendering) has not been checked in a game client.
- The resource pack's font and icon layout is generated for the current 26.x and 1.21.x formats. Check it in a client
  when you change it.
- Code is GPL-3.0-only. Users own the copied sources they install.
